title: Code review scorecard
score_scale: 0-5 per point; weights are fractions of the area total

points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.guidance: Clean documented build from a clean checkout; CMake or equivalent with configurable external dependency root (CFD_EXTERNALS_ROOT); no absolute machine paths; build works without manual case edits.
points.evidence: CMakeLists.txt and README build commands; try a clean configure/build.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.guidance: Required CLI form `solve --case <json> --output <dir>` works for every case; malformed inputs/missing meshes produce nonzero exit and clear messages; no hard-coded case names.
points.evidence: Argument parser, main(), error paths; spot-run bad input.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.guidance: Clear module boundaries; equation/physics interfaces not case-specific; BCs extensible; mesh/geometry abstractions could generalize to 3-D; structure supports EOS/RANS/species extension.
points.evidence: Directory layout, class/interface design, absence of case-specific branches.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.guidance: Solver core, time integration, and MPI communication are original; no copied/adapted/wrapped open-source CFD solver; no calls to existing solver executables; licenses respected.
points.evidence: Diff against known open-source CFD cores; provenance of large copied blocks; headers/comments.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.guidance: Cases drive behavior through JSON inputs; no branches on mesh filename or case id; production paths not special-cased per benchmark case.
points.evidence: grep for mesh/case names in source; input-driven parameters.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.guidance: Real neighbor halo exchange (isend/irecv or equivalent); global MPI reductions for residuals/forces; no full-state allgather or full-mesh replication during iterations; rank-independent output; partition diagnostics match the actual run.
points.evidence: Communication code review; metadata.json halo_exchange field; diagnostics.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.guidance: Bounds/error checks on mesh data and allocations; no full-mesh replication per rank during solve; no unbounded recursion or O(n^2) surprises; handles mixed cells and degenerate geometry.
points.evidence: Defensive checks; memory footprint on np=8; crash tests.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.guidance: Unit tests for geometry/flux/reconstruction where practical; smoke runs; serial-vs-parallel force comparison; validator run before submission.
points.evidence: tests/ dir, CI or run logs, validate_outputs.py output.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.guidance: Readable naming, comments on non-obvious numerics, no dead/debug code in submission, no leftover scratch files in tracked source, consistent formatting.
points.evidence: Skim sources; check for TODO/FIXME/abandoned experiments in tracked files.

disqualification_flags: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
